title: Yoko Ono awarded permanent custody of daughter Kyoko | 1973
content:
Yoko Ono was awarded permanent custody of her nine-year-old daughter Kyoko on 14 May 1973.

Ono and John Lennon had been in a custody battle for Kyoko since early 1971. The child was at an unknown location with her father Tony Cox, and Ono and Lennon were forced to undergo a series of court cases to try to locate her.

In a courtroom in Houston, Texas, on this day, Judge Peter Solito finally awarded Ono permanent custody of her daughter. However, since Kyoko could not be found, the ruling made little practical difference.
